data.gender_notes: Jahnvika is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jahnvika is a Sanskrit name derived from 'Jah' (victory) and 'Nika' (goddess). It signifies the goddess of victory, triumph, and success. In Hindu mythology, Jahnvika represents the divine feminine power that bestows strength, courage, and wisdom upon its bearer. The name Jahnvika carries the meaning “Goddess of victory” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jahnvika usually hope their child will grow to embody goddess of victory and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Embrace the divine feminine energy of victory and triumph.
data.etymology: Jahnvika belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Goddess of victory.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jahnvika total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

data.cultural_impact: Jahnvika is a rare and beautiful name in the Hindu culture, representing the Goddess of Victory and Triumph. In Hindu mythology, Goddess Victorious or Jahnavi is a form of Goddess Durga, who bestows her blessings upon her devotees, granting them strength, courage, and eventually, victory in their pursuits. The name signifies triumph over challenges, struggles, and adversities, and is a constant source of inspiration and motivation for those carrying it.
data.spiritual_significance: Jahnvika signifies the inner victory of the soul. It represents the triumph of the soul over its lower desires, leading it towards enlightenment and spiritual growth. The name is a reminder of the power of the divine feminine and encourages self-belief, determination, and resilience in the face of life's challenges. Furthermore, it resonates with the idea that the ultimate victory comes from within, and that our spiritual growth is a continuous journey towards self-realization.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Jahnvika: Radiant and victorious, embodiment of spiritual knowledge and inner peace. Her name signifies the overcoming of inner darkness through wisdom and the triumph of the soul in the pursuit of enlightenment.
